blurb: This Sunday's lesson words: He hath borne our griefs

cards.hint: Isaiah said to put this on like clothes when we wake up. (Isaiah 52:1)
He stands high up and shouts when he sees something coming. (Isaiah 52:8)
Isaiah said these are beautiful when they bring good news about Jesus. (Isaiah 52:7)
Jesus is called this because He was gentle and never fought back. (Isaiah 53:7)
The happy feeling when everyone is friends. (Isaiah 54:10)
Someone who does what God asks and takes care of others. (Isaiah 53:11)
It glows at night so we can see the way. (Isaiah 51:4)
God and I both make this special vow to each other. (Isaiah 54:10)

title: Isaiah 50–57
